plans.name: Annual Pass
plans.description:
Price includes 60 minutes per ride, after each unlock. 

For each trip >60 minutes: add $8 for each additional 30-minute period.

Pass valid for 365 days

plans.name: Guest Pass
plans.description:
60 min per ride, after each unlock. 
Pass valid for 24 hours.
For each trip >60 minutes: add $8 for each additional 30-minutes of ride time.

Pass is valid for 24 hours from time of purchase.

plans.name: Monthly Pass
plans.description:
Price includes 60 minutes per trip, after each unlock of a bike.

For each trip >60 minutes: add $8 for each additional 30-minute period.

Recurring monthly subscription (30 days)

plans.name: Single Ride Pass (30 min)
plans.description:
Price includes 30 minutes per ride, after each unlock.

If trip >30 minutes: add $8 for each additional 30-minute period.

Single Ride

plans.name: UW-Madison Monthly Member
plans.description: Includes rides of 30 minutes or less. Rides over 30 minutes incur $8 usage fee per additional 30 minutes. For active UW-Madison Students, Faculty, Staff.  Email verification required.
